text.en: Executive Order No. 256 dated December 8, 2003 is hereby

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 2ur day of ikvarker in the year of our
Lord, two thousand and four.
By the Fresident:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
